name: corvio-workspace
description: Find prior team work and preserve reusable reports, decisions, plans, notes, and project results through Corvio OAuth MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Find prior work and preserve reusable results.
interface.longDescription: Use Corvio alongside the host's normal workflow for research, reports, comparisons, proposals, plans, decisions, meeting notes, project work, debugging, reviews, and follow-ups. Retrieve authorized context, preserve results worth sharing or revisiting, and keep selected local-file access explicit.
defaultPrompt: Before research, reporting, planning, decision, meeting-note, project, or debugging work, search Corvio once for relevant prior material; continue normally if there is no match.
Turn this valuable result into the right durable Corvio artifact and preserve its source lineage.
Preview selected local agent work before importing it; do not capture unrelated private work.
